text.p: Results on the final day of four-day English county championship cricket matches on Saturday:
At Guildford: Surrey beat Hampshire by nine wickets. Surrey 477 and 78-1, Hampshire 303 and 251 (A.Aymes 96 not out, S.Renshaw 56; M.Bicknell 5-34). Surrey 24 points, Hampshire 7.
At Old Trafford: Lancashire beat Sussex by an innings and 18 runs. Lancashire 561-8 declared. Sussex 307 and 236 (W.Athey 53; G.Yates 5-59). Lancashire 24 points, Sussex 5.

At Northampton: Northamptonshire beat Essex by 15 runs. Northamptonshire 364 and 216 (D.Sales 63; A.Cowan 4-54). Essex 275 and 290 (P.Prichard 75, A.Grayson 62; J.Snape 4-46). Northamptonshire 24 points, Essex 6.

At Canterbury: Leicestershire beat Kent by 6 wickets. Kent 498-9 declared and 26-0 declared. Leicestershire 160-4 declared and 367-4 (B.Smith 121 not out, N.Johnson 117 not out). Kent 5 points, Leicestershire 19.
At Trent Bridge: Match drawn. Warwickshire 344 and 95-4. Nottinghamshire 133 and 415 (N.Astle 100, M.Dowman 96; A.Donald 5-98). Nottinghamshire 7 points, Warwickshire 10.
